result.instructions: Tools for Web3Forms, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the latest submissions of my contact form."; "How many submissions has each of my forms received?"; "Find submissions that mention pricing in the message field.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Web3Forms data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run web3forms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run web3forms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run web3forms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. web3forms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: web3forms_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List all Web3Forms forms in the account: form_id, form_name, created_at and total_count of submissions. Good first call to find a form_id. API: GET /forms.

tools.name: web3forms_list_submissions
tools.title: List submissions
tools.description: List submissions of one form, newest first, with fields, submitter IP address, user agent, site_url and attachments. Returns has_more and next_cursor: pass next_cursor as cursor to get the next page. API: GET /submissions.

tools.name: web3forms_get_submission
tools.title: Get a submission
tools.description: Get one submission by id (for example sub_a1b2c3d4e5f6), with its fields, IP address, user agent, site_url and attachments. API: GET /submissions/{id}.

tools.name: web3forms_create_submission
tools.title: Create a submission
tools.description: WRITE: create a submission on a form you own, as if a visitor sent it. It is stored, counts toward the monthly quota, and sends the notification email, autoresponder and integrations. Needs a key with the 'Create submissions' permission. There is NO idempotency key: if a call times out, check web3forms_list_submissions before you retry, or you may create a duplicate. API: POST /submissions.

form_id.description: The form to submit to (must be a form you own).

fields.description: Form fields as name/value pairs (1 to 100 entries).

replyto.description: Reply-To address of the notification email.

metadata.description: Attribution of the real submitter: ip, user_agent, site_url.
